subject: nahw
definition: A single utterance made for a single meaning. Every word is a noun, a verb or a particle.
explanation: A kalima is one word with one meaning, such as رَجُلٌ (a man) or ذَهَبَ (he went). The grammarians divide every word into three kinds, and nothing falls outside them: the noun (ism), the verb (fiʿl) and the particle (ḥarf).
A word on its own does not yet say anything complete. When words are joined so that the listener has a complete meaning, the result is kalām.
